script:
In Japan, women pay thousands of dollars just to talk to a handsome man.
Welcome to the host club — Tokyo's most expensive conversation.
Walk through Kabukicho at night and their faces are everywhere: giant billboards of men with perfect hair.
These are hosts. Professional charmers.
Inside, the walls show rankings — the top host is a celebrity with his own poster.
A bottle of champagne here can cost ten thousand dollars.
Order a champagne tower, and the whole club stops to celebrate you.
The number one hosts earn more than surgeons. Some make a million a year.
Their job: remember your birthday, text you good morning, make you feel like the only person in the world.
But here is the dark part.
Some women fall so deep, they take on debt to keep visiting.
There is even a word for spending everything on your host.
Girls work night jobs just to pay for one more evening of attention.
The club sells one product — and it isn't champagne.
It sells the feeling of being loved.
Would you pay for that?
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: In Japan, women pay thousands of dollars just to talk to a handsome man.
